title: Context Management Decision Framework
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Prompt Engineering
description: An interactive decision tree for choosing a context management strategy, from prompt compression through chunking to conversation history management, with hover details for every step.

learningObjectives: Select and justify an appropriate context management strategy for a given prompting task
Decide when to reset a long conversation

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Decision tree with hover-revealed diagnostic criteria at each fork
keyQuestions: Why is compression worth doing even with plenty of window to spare?
What does a context reset preserve, and what does it lose?
commonMisconceptions: Treating context management techniques as a checklist rather than alternatives
Believing the model remembers prior turns on its own
assessmentOpportunities: Route an unfamiliar task to a leaf and name the technique
State the symptom that triggers a context reset
